passage: Though often described as a solitary genius, the inventor relied heavily on a team of machinists and chemists. Recent biographies ______ the popular image by drawing on laboratory notebooks that record who actually performed each experiment.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
steps: The popular image: a solitary genius. The notebooks show a team did much of the work.
So the biographies make that image less simple: they complicate it.
“Reinforce” and “celebrate” would support the image; “predict” makes no sense.
key: Ask whether the new evidence supports or challenges the earlier view.
